payload.answer: (1) Invented credentials/metrics — prevented by leaving the prompt/guardrails untouched; (2) a blank or broken page when the bot is disabled — prevented by the server-rendered heading/intro plus the visible 'resting' notice; (3) duplicate-content or dead routes across the two hosts — prevented by the verified host rules (chat-host root serves [path]; other chat-host pages 308 to the hire host; hire-host [path] 308s to the chat root) and the canonical URL https://chat.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/; (4) assets or [path] failing on the chat host — prevented by the redirect regex excluding [path], [path] and file-extension paths.
